what: live_review_counterfactual.py replays the package bracket + a generic trail (trail_mult x atr behind the running extreme), NOT the leg's own monitor() as design section 5 specifies. MEASURED 2026-10-26 on 90 live closed crypto trades (untouched bracket replayed from entry): of the 22 whose replay reached an exit, 16 matched realised net R within 0.15R and 6 did not; 47 had no replay exit (strategy/pairs exits the replay does not model). Mismatching rows are not priced (could_not_price: replay_mismatch). Fix: replay through each leg's real monitor() so the mismatch/unresolved share falls; done when replay_mismatch + hold_replay_unresolved account for fewer than 1 in 10 of the tighten_sl reviews with a closed trade (denominator: all such reviews in comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl on main, measured once at least 20 exist).
